req.title: Pagination via skip and limit
req.statement: The system shall skip the first 'skip' items and cap the returned count at 'limit' when both are supplied to GET /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /tasks/?skip=<s>&limit=<l> skips the first 'skip' items and caps results at 'limit'. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — typical skip+limit returns correct slice; (2) boundary BVA — skip=0,limit=1 (minimum limit per constraint ge=1) returns exactly one item; (3) boundary BVA — limit at its maximum boundary (1000); (4) negative NEG — limit=0 violates ge=1 constraint and must return 422; (5) negative NEG — skip=-1 violates ge=0 constraint and must return 422; (6) DT — skip beyond total count returns empty list. Each test seeds its own data via POST, uses exact-value assertions, and checks both count and content to kill off-by-one and comparison mutations.

tests.name: test_skip_and_limit_returns_correct_slice
preconditions: Five tasks are created via POST /tasks/
actions: POST five tasks with distinct titles
expected: HTTP 200
Response body is a list of exactly 2 tasks
Returned tasks are the 3rd and 4th created (by insertion order)
trace: R-TASK-005: skip=2 skips first 2; limit=2 caps at 2
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
import sqlalchemy, os
from app.database import Base, engine

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

titles = [f"task_{i}" for i in range(5)]
for t in titles:
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": t, "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201

r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=2&limit=2")
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.json()
assert len(data) == 2
assert data[0]["title"] == "task_2"
assert data[1]["title"] == "task_3"

tests.name: test_skip_and_limit_combined_exact_slice_content
preconditions: Six tasks are created via POST /tasks/ with distinct titles
actions: POST six tasks titled task_0 through task_5
expected: HTTP 200
Exactly 2 tasks returned
First returned task title is task_3
Second returned task title is task_4
task_5 is NOT in the response (limit enforced)
trace: R-TASK-005: both skip and limit supplied; verifies skip offset AND limit cap simultaneously; kills mutations on offset/limit logic
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

for i in range(6):
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": f"task_{i}", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201

r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=3&limit=2")
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.json()
assert len(data) == 2
assert data[0]["title"] == "task_3"
assert data[1]["title"] == "task_4"
returned_titles = [d["title"] for d in data]
assert "task_5" not in returned_titles
assert "task_2" not in returned_titles
